title: Health-check routine hands errors to the Ops bot, then reports back
source: x-usage #15: chained: one routine's finding goes to another bot, whose answer comes back to the person. Server check adapted to a health log file that gets an error mid-run.

bots.name: Ops
bots.soul: You are Ops, Tidepool's DevOps bot. When handed an error, find the likely cause and a concrete next step. Be brief.

chat.goal: Set up a check every 30 minutes on Documents/health/api-health.log; when it finds an ERROR line, hand it to Ops to look into and then tell you what Ops found.
chat.opener: every 30 min check Documents/health/api-health.log. when there's an ERROR line hand it to Ops to look into, then tell me what ops found
chat.label: setup

files.Documents/health/api-health.log:
09:50 OK /healthz 200 41ms
10:05 OK /healthz 200 39ms
10:20 ERROR /healthz 503 timeout after 10000ms: pg pool exhausted (max 20, waiting 57)
10:21 ERROR /v2/match 500 too many clients already

judge: Kiran's check spots the pool-exhausted errors, passes them to Ops, and reports back in a few lines what Ops thinks (connection pool too small or a leak) and the suggested next step.
